name: Lolipop Nightmare!
original_name: ロリポップナイトメア！
source:
This is the first game by doujin circle studio hilite. Touka met a cheerful girl Phantasma in a cemetery in the outskirts of town. She told him with a broad smile that she was a witch and that if he helped her find what she was looking for, then she will made his love come true. Thus began a slightly strange love story which also roped in his osananajimi Mana.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/12/18/december-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是同人社团studio hilite的首部作品。冬香在城郊墓地遇见开朗少女菲安塔丝玛。她笑着告诉他自己是女巫，只要帮忙寻找她想要的东西，就会实现他的爱情。略显奇怪的爱情故事就此开始，青梅竹马麻那也被卷入其中。

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/12/18/december-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
